messages:
maya (docs): Hey team — working on the region availability + data residency page. Need quick verification before I open the PR. Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/region-availability-draft :eyes:
liam (product): Thanks Maya. High level check: are we listing 'Supported regions' separately from 'Data residency (where data can be stored)'? Those often get conflated by customers.
sarah (infra): We should split them. Supported regions = where inference endpoints run. Residency = where customer data-at-rest may be stored for logging/usage.
maya (docs): Great. I'm planning a table per region with columns: region code, human name, endpoint host, residency allowed (Y/N), notes. Any missing columns?
jen (docs): Add "latency profile"? maybe a simple tag (low/medium/high) — helps customers pick. But keep it optional.
liam (product): +1 on latency tag. Also add "deployment modes" small column (hosted/dedicated/private) — some regions only support hosted right now.
sarah (infra): FYI region codes: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, eu-north-1, ap-southeast-1. Hosted: all. Dedicated: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Private: N/A (customer-managed). Endpoints: api.{region}.redwood.ai for hosted.
nate (legal): For residency copy: careful with wording. Use "may be stored" and list exactly which telemetry is eligible for residency controls. Don't promise full residency for every artifact unless we have the contract feature.
maya (docs): Good catch. I'll draft: "Customer data may be stored within the selected region for model outputs, logs, and billing metadata where residency controls are enabled; consult your contract for specifics." Thoughts?
nate (legal): Better. Maybe add a link to the compliance page and say "subject to enrollment in Data Residency add-on" if that's accurate.
alex (sdk): Heads-up: SDK snippets need a small param example for selecting region and a note about fallbacks. e.g., JS snippet: ```js const client = new Redwood({region: 'eu-west-1'}); const res = await client.generate(...); ``` and Python: ```py client = Redwood(region='eu-west-1') resp = client.generate(...) ```
maya (docs): Perfect — can someone paste exact constructor param name? is it region or region_code?
alex (sdk): It's `region` in both SDKs. We'll include validation error example when unsupported region is passed.
jen (docs): I'll add a tiny migration note: "If you previously used the global endpoint, switch to region-specific endpoints by setting region in the SDK or using api.{region}.redwood.ai" with a short command line curl example.
sarah (infra): Also include a note about latency fallback: requests will not automatically cross-region unless you opt-in; we route based on region header.
maya (docs): I'll open a PR in ~30m. PR will include the table, SDK snippets, migration note, and legal link. Tagging reviewers: @liam @sarah @nate @alex @jen :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR lint passed for docs/region-availability.md — build preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1234
liam (product): I'll review after lunch. If legal sign-off line is good, we can ship as experimental and note "subject to change" for Dedicated rollouts in new regions.
maya (docs): Thanks all — will ping when PR is up.
